title: Peacock holding a heart
svg:

  <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f1c40f'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='2' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='37' r='2' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='38' x2='46' y2='42' stroke='#f1c40f' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='46' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#f1948a'/>

  <line x1='44' y1='87' x2='40' y2='94' stroke='#e67e22' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
